observations.behavior: Adds a required optional `version` parameter to the feature-flag enable/disable tool request body, while retaining the existing `id` parameter. The parameter is required when the flag's filters.version is 2, optional otherwise. The handler now includes this version in the request body. Documentation and tests are updated to reflect this change.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could support an agent or automation that toggles feature flags while preserving compatibility with flags that require version tracking. It could help prevent race conditions or version mismatches when changing a flag, potentially avoiding 409 conflicts.
